sources.publisher: Daniel G / Tall Dog Electronics, TinyNES hardware developer
sources.verified: Famicom uses 60 positions at 2.54 mm pitch; NES uses 72 positions at 2.50 mm pitch.

Famicom_2x30_cartridge_connector.kicad_mod pads 1–60 use 2.54 mm pitch and Y=±2.54 mm. The auxiliary 15-pin footprint uses an approximate 2.75 mm grid; it corroborates layout, not factory mating tolerances.
Compatible standard-density DA-15 nominal contact pitch is 2.77 mm, with a 2.84 mm row gap. This does not identify the Nintendo OEM connector or establish its custom depth and pin diameter.
Firsthand peripheral builders report that the original Famicom port is deeper and its pins thicker than a stock D-sub. Its custom housing and depth are retained.

Original HVC-001 photographs show thirteen rear ventilation slots, recessed POWER/RESET fields, an expansion port offset to the right, its metal surround and amber insulator, and the gold rule on the front nameplate.
A demonstrated Famicom power-board design specifies a 5.5 x 2.1 mm DC jack; this is interface compatibility evidence, not an OEM housing drawing.
Compatible RCA plug: centre pin 3.25 +0/-0.15 mm, 8 mm exposed beyond a 5.5 mm long, 9 mm diameter sleeve. The model selects 3.20 mm within that range; local overmold remains estimated.
Compatible RCA jack: 8.30 mm exterior and 3.60 mm entrance opening. Nintendo OEM part identity and spring-contact tolerances are not established.

changes.scope: Reader solder legs and PCB bores
changes.basis: Selected GPM-02 compatible PCB footprint; spring bends and housing remain estimated.
Compatible DA-15 nominal grid; OEM tolerances and PCB-tail bends are not verified.
Thirteen complete rear openings in a continuous recessed field; shallow POWER/RESET control fields restored from official photos.
Photograph-fitted rightward offset, separate metal rim and recessed insulator. Pin diameter and depth remain unmeasured.
Official-photo color estimates and nameplate rules; controller display leads rebuilt with analytic arcs after legacy C0 continuity errors. Their free cable pose is illustrative.
Nintendo hero photograph shows a red expansion-port cap; reconstructed as a separately displayed accessory with fitted dimensions.
Correct the adapter barrel to 5.5 x 2.1 mm and RCA pin/sleeve to compatible manufacturer dimensions; clear the schematic RF shield along both insertion paths.

limitations: No physical hardware measurements were performed.
Compatible PCB and connector references constrain mating grids, not OEM housing walls or contact-spring tolerances.
Cartridge pad length, PCB thickness, outer shells and internal PCB traces remain approximate.
Custom expansion-port diameter and depth are retained as existing estimates; physical interchangeability is not certified.
The front wordmark uses approximate typography; controller paint graphics and flexible cable lengths are not complete factory reproductions.

exterior_fit.basis: Counts and presence from official photographs; local coordinates, dimensions, curvature and display colors are fitted estimates. No metrology or color calibration.

legacy_geometry_repairs.method: Analytic display routes, helix splitting and unrefined Boolean output. Mainboard change verified by empty bidirectional Boolean differences. Other cable poses are reconstructed, not asserted geometrically identical to old splines.
